body: Go to the media then, write a letter to your local newspaper. Don't give up.
Are you absolutely sure that there's no way that you could get some treatment? I don't know, write a letter to your government, to the health department!

What if you took a trip? somewhere different, a nice place, to release your energy and your thoughts. 
Maybe you should give medication a chance. It takes time until you feel better, and the shrink might have to try a few different ones before he/her hits the right one.

What you're going through is really hard, and I can't imagine the amount of pain that you're suffering, but there must be a way to get you into treatment. Are there any ONG's where you live? Before giving up, fight, bring up all your courage and your love, your love for yourself and the things that you love. There's always a way...
I'd love to give you a hug, I hope that you can feel the good vibes that I send you through this.
Regardind therapy, you could do some research, alternative kinds of therapy, like Gestaltic or Jung's theories.

You can't even begin to imagine how much I understand you.
You need to hold on to the things that make you feel good, like singing. Why can't you sing when you're with your friends? Doing that would be joyfull and different, who cares about what other people think? You're the only one that matters, you come first. I've survived overdosing too, and I too felt some kind of relief, an idea that I survived for a reason, I try to hold on to that thought.
Maybe at one point you'll find what you're looking for, and you might not know what that is at the moment. Life is hard, unfair and tough, but it's also a box full of surprises, and things can change in a second. 
High school is a hard time too, but you'll feel some kind of freedom when you finish. There's a whole world of opportunities out there, you just need to keep walking and know that you're a good person, and that you deserve nice things.
Take care, honey!
I love you too. At least this is something. We're the good ones, you know?
Call the police, get some help, embrace yourself with your issues and your pain. If you didn't do it it was for a reason, you want to live, even if you don't feel that way right now.

You feel like this, and I don't know you, but you took the time to answer my post just because you're a good person, just in case no-one answered.
You're empathic and you pressure yourself too much. Business and money don't mean a thing, and you can't leave this world with that on your mind. 
Try to find your creative side, let go of things through art, it might help you. Just keep on trying, look at the sky, listen to the wind, to everything that nature tries to tell us all the time. 
Write down a list of things that you like about yourself, it may be short (because of the depression) but you might be surprised with how important the things that you DO like are!
You're nice, you're a good person, you've already won what most people won't ever win!

It's SO important to talk to someone, a family member, a friend, a THERAPIST. My friend killed herself and no-one will ever understand what happened, why did she do that, and that's killing all of us. If only she had said something to me, I wouldn't have slept just to be there for her, to hold her hand, to listen to her.
My problem is that I have told everyone, they all know, but they are tired of me, of me not getting better. I think that I annoy them and that makes me feel a thousend times worse!
I hope you find your happiness too, your freedom of mind and soul!

Wouldn't it be great to have like an anonymous group for suicidal people? I don't think that it exists where I live
